RNG: Unchanged default RNG inventory/calls; restoration attempted after a complete snapshot. Snapshot/restoration failure is explicit. A secondary restoration failure preserves an already pending capture/observer exception.
additional_metrics: VALIDATION served accuracy/NLL/Brier and member accuracy/NLL/Brier from captured logits, CPU float64; reporting only
endpoint: last completed native continuation update, before validation-NLL selected model restoration
failure: Exclusive run-level attempt marker before constructor/loading; best-effort run-level failure sidecar for every subsequent wrapper failure; terminal REPORT_FAILED.json only in this attempt-owned directory; entire receipt construction/write protected; original error propagated; no retry/overwrite.
failure_receipt_fields: Stage; safely available endpoint, update/stop/selected/source NLL, capture costs and unknown field inventory; source bindings with availability/verification status; owned partial-file inventory or explicit unavailable inventory.
full_cap_endpoint: Only when unchanged native schedule actually reaches cap; otherwise report native patience endpoint and actual updates
limits: Source AST equivalence is not a numerical native-runtime replay test.
Reporting source copy must be independently reviewed and qualified at the exact native runtime before launch.
Validation descriptors copied from caller are not independently verified by this observer.
Additional float64 CPU NLL is not bitwise identical to the original native-device FP32 checkpoint metric and cannot silently replace it.
No heldout evidence, predictive improvement, novelty or acceptance follows from this source preparation.
Invalid/unwritable run roots or an unavailable exclusive attempt marker can prevent durable run-level reporting; no unsafe fallback path or overwrite is used.
Receipt IO/construction failure may prevent the receipt itself; it must not replace the original exception.
Snapshot or restoration failure does not establish RNG restoration. Custom generators and unrelated backends remain outside the unchanged canonical RNG inventory.
Source-only AST checks do not exercise exception paths or establish full native-runtime, RNG or metric equivalence.
native_source_NLL: Last existing native pooled validation cross-entropy scalar; source selection/screen arithmetic is retained
observer_inputs: cloned CPU logits, scalar endpoint metadata; caller supplies already authorized VALIDATION pack and verified descriptors
reporting_cost: Completed/partial hook capture wall and process CPU; observer body and wrapper failure intervals; available restore intervals. Overlapping scopes must not be summed. Successful final JSON/RNG restore and receipt construction/write are not claimed as measured end-to-end training cost.
scope: Observation-only source preparation; no execution or scientific result
served_raw_logits: Mean across member axis on the native device, copied without precision conversion to CPU
